summary: Generate Markdown documentation with Mermaid diagrams for Salesforce flows
description: Creates rich documentation including flow diagrams. Use --separate to generate one file per flow.
flags.directory: Directory to scan for .flow-meta.xml files (default: current directory)
flags.output: Output directory or file (behavior depends on --separate)
flags.separate: Generate one Markdown file per flow in the output directory
flags.noDetails: Omit detailed node and variable tables
flags.raw: Output only raw Mermaid code blocks (no Markdown wrapper)
